verdict.seen: Soil clods fly in the first frame, then a flat tan wall face covers the ground in the next two. No ditch is visible along the house.
verdict.problem: No dug ditch is visible, only a flat tan face; show an open trench along the wall with soil being dug out.

verdict.seen: Rain falls harder on the house across the frames, and blue water collects along the wall base and on the lawn.
The blue water in the ditch along the wall rises and fills it while rain keeps falling.
Arrows point up in the flooded ditch, then a close view shows a crack opening in the wall at the waterline.
The crack is shown first, then the ditch is filled with gravel up to the wall, with a bluish layer at the bottom.
A perforated white pipe appears under the gravel, and the gravel sits on top of it.
A gravel trench with a pipe under it and a thin yellow line at the bottom. The outline is faint and the trench edge is barely marked.
verdict.problem: The trench outline is only a thin yellow line at the bottom; make it a clear outline around the whole trench.

verdict.seen: Blue dots flow along the sloped pipe down to a gravel soakaway, with a down arrow below.
Gravel with a pipe and some soil crumbs on the surface. No fabric wrap is visible around the gravel.
verdict.problem: The fabric wrap around the gravel is not visible; show a distinct fabric sheet around the gravel.

verdict.seen: A French flag stands on the lawn and is then crossed out with a red X.
A red sign reading Farm Drainage, H. F. French, 1859 stands on the lawn and is readable.
The gravel trench is capped with grass across the frames, and small bushes appear by the house.
The whole finished French drain is in view, with the house, shrubs, gravel, pipe and soakaway all clear.
